@graph.name: Port of Huntington Tri-State Logistics Dataset
@graph.description: The per-port dataset for the Port of Huntington Tri-State in the Ports & Intermodal program of The Flat Rate Movers: the full port record for the inland river port district — a U.S. Port Statistical Area of 199 navigable river miles (Ohio River 100, Kanawha River 90, Big Sandy River 9) across West Virginia, Ohio and Kentucky, overseen by the Huntington District Waterways Association — its anchor points (Huntington and Kenova, WV; Catlettsburg, KY; South Point, OH), its sourced facilities (the Marathon Petroleum Catlettsburg refinery docks; McGinnis Inc. at South Point; 18 active Ohio-side freight docks), cargo specialties (coal, petroleum products, chemicals, limestone and aggregates, steel), Norfolk Southern and CSX rail service, the US-52 / I-64 highway corridors, the USACE CY2023 tonnage on the Port Statistical Area basis (29,699,657 short tons — the district moves tens of millions of tons annually on every published basis), and the branch binding: the district is served from the Winchester, VA branch, about 312.8 road miles away (Martinsburg measures 357.7 to 360.4). The company's eight attached port services are recorded cell by cell in the companion coverage dataset. No port tenancy or port-authority relationship is claimed; the company's crews hold TWIC cards and its contractors hold valid TWIC cards.

@graph.name: Port of Huntington Tri-State Service Coverage Dataset
@graph.description: The service-coverage cells for the Port of Huntington Tri-State in the Ports & Intermodal program: the eight attached services (transloading; ocean container packing and unpacking; loading and unloading / container labor; cross-docking; freight rework; specialized workforce; logistics project management; 3PL support services), each recorded as offered with its delivery points (port-adjacent warehouse, receiver's dock, yard, leased space, and on-terminal by arrangement — on-terminal work happens only by arrangement through the terminal's own processes, never as a bare claim) and its bound branch, Winchester, VA. Drayage is not offered at any port in the program.

@graph.name: Port of Huntington Tri-State
@graph.description: Port of Huntington Tri-State (Huntington, WV) — inland river port district (barge, bulk, breakbulk) — a U.S. Port Statistical Area spanning the Ohio, Kanawha and Big Sandy rivers in West Virginia, Ohio and Kentucky. Authority: Huntington District Waterways Association (the district is a Port Statistical Area, not a single port authority). Operator: Multiple private terminal and dock operators across the district (no single operator). Cargo: coal and lignite; gasoline, distillate fuel oil and petroleum products; chemicals; limestone and aggregates; steel-related cargo; crude materials. Rail: Norfolk Southern — serves the Ohio-side docks; mainline on the WV shore of the Big Sandy; CSX — serves the district; mainline on the KY shore of the Big Sandy. Highway corridors: US-52, I-64, US-23, US-60, US-32. Volume (CY2023, calendar): 29,699,657 short tons — Port Statistical Area basis — the district moves tens of millions of tons annually on every published basis; this is the USACE figure on the PSA basis (source: USACE Top-50 ports list (2023), via WV program research verification 2026-11-07). Branch binding: this port is served from the Winchester, VA branch of The Flat Rate Movers — about 312.8 road miles from Winchester and 359 from Martinsburg; bound to Winchester on miles. about 45 mi closer from Winchester (measured range 357.7-360.4 mi from Martinsburg).
